description: This module provides CRUD operations and service-layer functions for recipes, ingredients, and tags within a recipe management backend. It includes functions for creating, listing, fetching, updating, and deleting recipes, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

methods.name: List[Tag] _get_or_create_tags(db: Session, tag_names: List[str])
methods.description: Internal helper function to retrieve existing tags or create new ones based on a list of tag names.

methods.name: Recipe create_recipe(db: Session, payload: RecipeCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new recipe with associated ingredients and tags, and persists it to the database.

methods.name: List[Recipe] list_recipes(db: Session, q: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recipes, optionally filtered by a search query in title or description.

methods.name: Optional[Recipe] get_recipe(db: Session, recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single recipe by its unique ID.

methods.name: Optional[Recipe] update_recipe(db: Session, recipe_id: int, payload: RecipeUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe's details, ingredients, and tags based on provided payload.

methods.name: bool delete_recipe(db: Session, recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a recipe by its ID, returning True if successful, False if not found.

ctags.name: list_recipes
ctags.pattern: /^def list_recipes(db: Session, q: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Recipe]:$/

ctags.name: update_recipe
ctags.pattern: /^def update_recipe(db: Session, recipe_id: int, payload: RecipeUpdate) -> Optional[Recipe]:$/
